title: Home practical guide and safety card: sugar test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lessons 31, 32 (Home practical guide and safety card: sugar test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 31: What makes sugar dissolve faster? Planning. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out if water temperature changes how fast sugar dissolves
equipment: Cold, room-temperature and warm tap water (adult checks)
safety: Warm tap water only, never boiling
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Pour the same volume of water into each cup
Measure the temperature of each if you have a thermometer
Drop one sugar cube into each cup at the same time
Stir each the same way, ten stirs every 30 seconds
Time how long each cube takes to dissolve

questions.q: The one thing we change is the...
Big question: why does sugar vanish faster in a hot drink?
questions.a: Warm water particles move faster, so the sugar breaks up and spreads faster.
